feature1.prompt: ModelForm RadioSelect widget for foreign keys should not present a blank option if blank=False on the model. Unlike the select widget where a blank option is idiomatic even for required fields, the RadioSelect widget has an inherent unfilled state that makes the '-------' option appear as if it were a valid choice. In this feature the focus is on ensuring that the blank attribute defined on the model is properly propagated into the form field configuration. When a new form is rendered from a model with a foreign key that has blank=False, no default blank option should be included in the rendered RadioSelect widget.
feature1.hint_texts: Modify the formfield method in django/db/models/fields/related.py so that the returned dictionary includes the model field's 'blank' attribute. Developers should update the kwargs passed from the model field to the form field, ensuring that 'blank': self.blank is added. This change guarantees that the form field reflects the intended configuration from the model.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/db/models/fields/related.py; Function: formfield (around line 980) – update the kwargs dictionary to include 'blank': self.blank.

feature2.prompt: ModelForm RadioSelect widget for foreign keys should not present a blank option if blank=False on the model. This feature focuses on refining the behavior of the ModelChoiceField when a RadioSelect widget is used. The fix must ensure that when a foreign key field defined with blank=False is rendered, the RadioSelect widget does not display any default blank option. The expected outcome is that no blank (placeholder) input is rendered, so that a user is not misled by an unintended valid selection.
feature2.hint_texts: Update the ModelChoiceField initializer in django/forms/models.py to incorporate a check for the RadioSelect widget and the blank parameter. If the widget is an instance of RadioSelect and blank is False, then set self.empty_label to None to prevent a blank option from appearing. Developers should focus on the conditional logic in the __init__ method to correctly adjust the empty_label value.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/forms/models.py; Class: ModelChoiceField; Method: __init__ (around line 1184) – specifically the code block that checks if self.widget is a RadioSelect and blank is False, then assigns self.empty_label = None.
